result.title: Compositional Average Velocity Modeling for Efficient Diffusion Offline Reinforcement Learning
result.summary: Diffusion-based policies have recently emerged as a powerful paradigm for offline reinforcement learning, but their reliance on multi-step denoising introduces substantial computational overhead and requires backpropagation through time during training, limiting scalability and practical deployment. In this work, we propose \textbf{Instant Flow Q-Learning (InsQL)}, a single-step generative policy learning framework that retains the expressive capacity of diffusion models while eliminating iterative sampling and BPTT. InsQL builds on the flow-matching perspective of diffusion policies, but replaces marginal velocity parameterization with \emph{average-velocity} modeling and introduces a principled compositional mechanism, yielding a theoretically grounded objective that learns average velocity consistently across scales. This formulation provides a direct noise-to-action mapping and enables single-step action generation. InsQL further unifies compositional average-velocity modeling with behavior-regularized actor--critic optimization in a single framework, requiring only a single policy network and avoiding distillation, multi-stage procedures, and Jacobian computations during training. At inference time, actions are generated in a single forward pass and can be refined via value-guided candidate selection to improve performance. Extensive experiments on standard offline RL benchmarks and real-world robotic manipulation tasks show that InsQL matches or surpasses state-of-the-art diffusion-based methods while substantially reducing both training and inference time. Overall, these results establish compositional average-velocity modeling as an efficient and scalable alternative to multi-step generative policies for offline RL.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 InsQL：把扩散策略的多步去噪换成平均速度建模与组合式 flow-matching，实现单步动作生成，并与行为正则 actor-critic 统一训练，还用价值引导的候选筛选提升性能，在离线 RL 基准与机器人任务上降低训练和推理开销。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「平均速度」单步生成与价值引导候选筛选，可能为 diffusion 式 latent 推理状态的低成本生成及候选验证／停止决策提供方法线索，可供核查；但本文面向离线 RL 动作生成，跨域迁移属推测。
